name: Mojito
steps: Press the lime, mint and sugar gently in the glass.
Add the rum and crushed ice, then stir to mix.
Top with soda and lift the mint from the bottom once.
notes: Press mint lightly; tearing it makes the drink bitter.

name: Negroni
steps: Pour everything into a mixing glass with ice.
Strain over a large cube and express an orange peel.
notes: Equal parts; easy to scale for batching.

name: Margarita
steps: Salt half the rim of the glass if wanted.
Shake all liquids hard with ice.
notes: Skip the agave if the orange liqueur is sweet.

name: Old Fashioned
steps: Stir the syrup and bitters in the glass.
Add whiskey and a large cube, stir for about 20 seconds.
Express an orange peel over the top.
notes: Rye works well for a drier drink.

name: Daiquiri
steps: Shake everything with ice until the tin is frosty.
Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
notes: Taste and adjust the syrup to the limes you have.

name: Dry Martini
steps: Stir gin and vermouth with ice for 30 seconds.
notes: Keep the glass in the freezer first.

name: Manhattan
steps: Stir all ingredients with ice until cold.
notes: Fresh vermouth matters; keep it in the fridge.

name: Cosmopolitan
steps: Fine strain into a chilled glass.
Flame or express an orange peel on top.

name: Whiskey Sour
steps: Shake without ice for a few seconds.
Add ice and shake again until cold.
notes: Leave out the egg white for a lighter drink.

name: Espresso Martini
steps: Brew the espresso and let it cool slightly.
Shake very hard with ice for a thick foam.
Fine strain and float three beans.
notes: Hard shaking is what makes the foam.

name: Aperol Spritz
steps: Fill a wine glass with ice.
Add the sparkling wine, then the aperitif.
Finish with soda and an orange slice.
notes: Build in this order to keep the colour layered.

name: Moscow Mule
steps: Top with ginger beer and stir once.

name: Paloma
steps: Add tequila, lime and salt to an ice-filled glass.
Top with grapefruit soda and stir gently.

name: Piña Colada
steps: Blend everything with a scoop of crushed ice until smooth.
Pour into the glass and garnish.
notes: Add a little more ice if it is too thin.

name: Mai Tai
steps: Add mint and a spent lime shell.
notes: Two rums give depth; one good aged rum also works.

name: Tom Collins
steps: Add gin, lemon and syrup to an ice-filled glass.
Top with soda and stir lightly.

name: Caipirinha
steps: Muddle the lime and sugar to release the juice.
Stir and add more ice on top.
notes: Cachaça is distilled from fresh sugarcane juice.

name: Bloody Mary
steps: Add all ingredients to a glass with ice.
Roll between two glasses or stir to mix.
notes: Season to taste before serving.

name: Sidecar
steps: Sugar half the rim if wanted.
Shake with ice and fine strain.

name: Boulevardier
notes: A whiskey cousin of the Negroni.

name: Penicillin
steps: Shake the blended Scotch, lemon and syrup with ice.
Float the smoky Scotch on top.
notes: Make the syrup by simmering honey with sliced ginger.

name: Last Word
steps: Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
notes: Equal parts.

name: French 75
steps: Shake gin, lemon and syrup with ice.
Strain into a flute and top with sparkling wine.

name: Dark 'n' Stormy
steps: Fill a glass with ice and add ginger beer.
notes: Floating the rum gives the stormy look.

name: Pisco Sour
steps: Strain and dot bitters on the foam.

name: Bramble
steps: Shake gin, lemon and syrup, then strain over crushed ice.
Drizzle the berry liqueur on top.

name: Aviation
steps: Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
notes: Go easy on the violet liqueur.

name: Long Island Iced Tea
steps: Add all spirits, lemon juice and syrup to an ice-filled glass.
Top with a splash of cola and stir.

name: Cuba Libre
steps: Add rum and lime, top with cola and stir.

name: Gin & Tonic
steps: Fill a large glass with ice.
notes: Use very cold tonic from a fresh bottle.

name: Sazerac
steps: Rinse a chilled glass with absinthe and discard the extra.
Stir whiskey, syrup and bitters with ice.
Strain into the rinsed glass and express a lemon peel.

name: Mint Julep
steps: Lightly press the mint with the syrup in the cup.
Add bourbon and crushed ice, then stir until the cup frosts.
Top with more ice and a mint bouquet.

name: Tequila Sunrise
steps: Pour tequila and juice over ice and stir.
Slowly drop grenadine down the side so it settles.

name: Amaretto Sour
steps: Shake without ice, then with ice.

name: Americano
steps: Add bitter and vermouth to an ice-filled glass.
Top with soda and stir gently.

name: Bellini
steps: Chill the glass and purée first.
Pour the purée, then top slowly with prosecco and stir once.

name: Mimosa
steps: Pour sparkling wine into a flute.

name: Kir Royale
steps: Add the liqueur to a flute.

name: Sangria Glass
steps: Add everything to a glass with ice.
Stir and let sit one minute before serving.
notes: Better as a batch made hours earlier.

name: White Russian
steps: Add vodka and coffee liqueur to a glass with ice.

name: Black Russian
steps: Pour both over ice in a rocks glass.

name: Rusty Nail
steps: Stir gently and express a lemon peel.

name: Hemingway Daiquiri
steps: Fine strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Tommy's Margarita
notes: A simple margarita without orange liqueur.

name: Mezcal Negroni
steps: Strain over a large cube and add an orange peel.

name: Vesper
steps: Shake with ice until very cold.
Strain into a chilled glass and add a thick lemon peel.

name: Corpse Reviver No. 2
steps: Add a dash of absinthe to the glass or the tin.
Fine strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Irish Coffee
steps: Warm the mug with hot water, then empty it.
Stir whiskey, sugar and coffee until dissolved.
Float the cream on top over a spoon.

name: Hot Toddy
steps: Stir honey, lemon and whiskey in a warm mug.
Add hot water and stir again.

name: Greyhound
steps: Pour vodka into a glass with ice.
Top with grapefruit juice and stir.

name: Bee's Knees
steps: Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
notes: Make honey syrup with equal parts honey and warm water.

name: Southside
steps: Add everything to a shaker with ice.
Shake hard, then fine strain into a chilled coupe.
Float a mint leaf on top.
notes: Shake with the mint so it releases oil without bruising.
menuDescription: Gin, lime and mint shaken cold and served up.

name: Hanky Panky
steps: Stir all ingredients with ice until very cold.
Express an orange twist over the top.
notes: Use only a small amount of amaro; it should whisper.
menuDescription: Gin and sweet vermouth with a bitter amaro edge.

name: Martinez
steps: Add all to a mixing glass with ice.
Stir until chilled and strain into a coupe.
notes: The forerunner of the Manhattan and Martini.
menuDescription: Old Tom gin and sweet vermouth, softly sweet.

name: Gin Fizz
steps: Shake gin, lemon and syrup with ice.
Strain into a tall glass over fresh ice.
notes: Pour soda last to keep the fizz lively.
menuDescription: Tall, crisp gin sour lengthened with soda.

name: Ramos Gin Fizz
steps: Shake everything except soda without ice for a long time.
Add ice and shake again until very cold.
Strain into a chilled glass and top slowly with soda so the foam rises.
notes: Long shaking builds the tall silky foam.
menuDescription: Silky, creamy citrus gin fizz with a tall foam top.

name: Singapore Sling
steps: Shake all but soda with ice.
Strain into a tall glass over fresh ice.
menuDescription: Fruity, long gin drink with cherry and pineapple.

name: White Lady
steps: Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
notes: Add an egg white for a silkier body if you like.
menuDescription: Bright gin, orange liqueur and lemon served up.

name: Gin Basil Smash
steps: Gently press the basil in the shaker.
Add the rest with ice and shake hard.
notes: Use fresh, firm basil leaves.
menuDescription: Fresh basil, lemon and gin over ice.

name: Gibson
steps: Stir gin and vermouth with ice until very cold.
Add a cocktail onion on a pick.
notes: A Dry Martini with an onion instead of olive or twist.
menuDescription: Dry gin martini finished with a cocktail onion.

name: Gin Rickey
steps: Top with soda and stir once.
notes: No sugar; it is dry and sharp.
menuDescription: Dry, tart gin and lime highball.

name: Bronx
steps: Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
menuDescription: Gin, both vermouths and fresh orange juice.

name: Fitzgerald
steps: Shake gin, lemon and syrup with ice.
Add the bitters on top and a lemon twist.
menuDescription: A gin sour finished with Angostura bitters.

name: Breakfast Martini
steps: Add all to a shaker and stir to dissolve the marmalade.
Add ice, shake hard and fine strain into a coupe.
menuDescription: Gin sour with a spoon of orange marmalade.

name: Sea Breeze
menuDescription: Vodka with cranberry and grapefruit juice.

name: Cape Codder
steps: Pour in the vodka, then the cranberry juice.
Stir and add a lime wedge.
menuDescription: Simple vodka and cranberry highball.

name: Harvey Wallbanger
steps: Build vodka and orange juice over ice.
menuDescription: Screwdriver with a float of vanilla-herbal liqueur.

name: Lemon Drop
menuDescription: Sweet-tart lemon vodka sour with a sugar rim.

name: Porn Star Martini
steps: Serve with a shot of sparkling wine on the side.
notes: The sparkling wine is sipped alongside.
menuDescription: Passion fruit and vanilla vodka served up with bubbles on the side.

name: Screwdriver
notes: Fresh juice makes all the difference.
menuDescription: Vodka and fresh orange juice.

name: Kamikaze
notes: Often served as a shot; this is the sipping version.
menuDescription: Equal parts vodka, orange liqueur and lime.

name: Bay Breeze
menuDescription: Vodka with pineapple and cranberry juice.

name: Madras
steps: Top with orange juice and stir.
menuDescription: Vodka, cranberry and orange juice.

name: Sex on the Beach
steps: Add the juices and stir lightly.
menuDescription: Fruity vodka, peach, orange and cranberry long drink.

name: Salty Dog
steps: Salt half the rim of a highball.
Fill with ice, add vodka and grapefruit juice.
menuDescription: Vodka and grapefruit with a salted rim.

name: Appletini
steps: Strain into a chilled martini glass.
menuDescription: Green apple vodka cocktail served up.

name: French Martini
steps: Shake all ingredients hard with ice.
Fine strain into a chilled martini glass.
notes: Shake hard to build a light foam.
menuDescription: Vodka, raspberry liqueur and pineapple juice.

name: Zombie
steps: Add everything to a shaker with ice.
Shake well and pour into a tiki glass with crushed ice.
Garnish with a big mint sprig.
notes: Strong; serve one per guest.
menuDescription: Potent multi-rum tiki drink with citrus and spice.

name: Painkiller
steps: Pour into a tiki glass over crushed ice.
menuDescription: Creamy pineapple, orange and coconut rum drink.

name: Hurricane
steps: Strain into a tall glass over fresh ice.
menuDescription: Rum and passion fruit tiki classic.

name: El Presidente
steps: Stir all ingredients with ice until cold.
menuDescription: Rum with dry vermouth, a Cuban stirred classic.

name: Planter's Punch
steps: Shake rum, lime, syrup and bitters with ice.
Strain into a tall glass over fresh ice.
menuDescription: Rum, lime and spice punch, long and refreshing.

name: Queen's Park Swizzle
steps: Add mint, lime and syrup to a tall glass and press lightly.
Add rum and crushed ice, then swizzle until frosty.
Top with more ice and dash bitters on top.
menuDescription: Minty rum swizzle with a bitters finish.

name: Rum Old Fashioned
steps: Stir all ingredients with ice until chilled.
menuDescription: Aged rum stirred with bitters and a touch of sugar.

name: Mary Pickford
steps: Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
menuDescription: Light rum with pineapple, grenadine and cherry.

name: Ti' Punch
steps: Squeeze a lime wedge into the glass.
Stir and add ice if you like.
notes: Traditionally everyone mixes their own.
menuDescription: French Caribbean mix of agricole rum, lime and cane syrup.

name: Blue Hawaii
steps: Strain into a tiki glass over crushed ice.
menuDescription: Bright blue pineapple and rum tropical drink.

name: Strawberry Daiquiri
menuDescription: Frozen strawberry, lime and rum blend.

name: Oaxaca Old Fashioned
steps: Stir all ingredients with ice until chilled.
Express an orange peel over the glass.
menuDescription: Smoky agave twist on the Old Fashioned.

name: Naked and Famous
steps: Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
notes: Equal parts.
menuDescription: Equal-parts mezcal sour with herbal and bitter notes.

name: El Diablo
steps: Top with ginger beer and stir lightly.
menuDescription: Tequila, cassis, lime and ginger beer.

name: Batanga
steps: Salt the rim of a tall glass.
Fill with ice and add tequila and lime.
Top with cola and stir with a knife.
menuDescription: Tequila and cola with lime and a salted rim.

name: Spicy Margarita
garnish: Chili salt rim and jalapeno slice
steps: Gently press the jalapeno in the shaker.
Add the rest with ice and shake.
Strain over ice into a chili-salt-rimmed glass.
notes: Adjust heat with more or fewer slices.
menuDescription: Margarita with fresh jalapeno heat.

name: Matador
menuDescription: Tequila, pineapple and lime, bright and easy.

name: Siesta
steps: Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
menuDescription: Tequila, red bitter and grapefruit, lightly tart.

name: Division Bell
steps: Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
notes: Equal parts.
menuDescription: Smoky mezcal, bitter aperitif and lime, served up.

name: Mexican Mule
steps: Fill a copper mug with ice.
Top with ginger beer and stir once.
menuDescription: Moscow Mule made with tequila.

name: Vieux Carré
menuDescription: New Orleans stirred drink of rye, cognac and vermouth.

name: Paper Plane
steps: Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
notes: Equal parts.
menuDescription: Equal-parts bourbon sour with bittersweet amaro.

name: Gold Rush
notes: Honey syrup is 3 parts honey to 1 part water.
menuDescription: Bourbon, lemon and honey over a big cube.

name: Brown Derby
steps: Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
menuDescription: Bourbon, grapefruit and honey.

name: Rob Roy
notes: A Manhattan made with Scotch.
menuDescription: Scotch Manhattan.

name: Blood and Sand
steps: Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
notes: Equal parts.
menuDescription: Scotch, cherry and orange in equal parts.

name: Ward Eight
steps: Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
menuDescription: Rye sour with orange and grenadine from Boston.

name: New York Sour
steps: Shake whiskey, lemon and syrup with ice.
Float the red wine slowly on top.
menuDescription: Whiskey sour topped with a red wine float.

name: Godfather
steps: Add scotch and amaretto to a rocks glass over ice.
menuDescription: Scotch with almond liqueur.

name: Scofflaw
steps: Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
menuDescription: Rye, dry vermouth, lemon and grenadine.

name: Revolver
steps: Stir all ingredients with ice until chilled.
Flame an orange peel over the drink.
menuDescription: Bourbon with coffee liqueur, stirred.

name: Bobby Burns
menuDescription: Scotch, sweet vermouth and a hint of herbal liqueur.

name: Whiskey Smash
steps: Gently press the mint in the shaker.
Add the rest with ice and shake hard.
menuDescription: Bourbon with lemon and fresh mint.

name: Algonquin
steps: Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
menuDescription: Rye, dry vermouth and pineapple juice.

name: Between the Sheets
steps: Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
menuDescription: Cognac, rum and orange liqueur sour.

name: Stinger
steps: Stir cognac and creme de menthe with ice.
menuDescription: Cognac cooled with mint liqueur.

name: Japanese Cocktail
menuDescription: Cognac and almond syrup with bitters.

name: Champs-Élysées
steps: Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
menuDescription: Cognac sour with herbal liqueur.

name: Horse's Neck
steps: Hang a long lemon spiral in a highball glass.
Fill with ice and add cognac and bitters.
menuDescription: Cognac and ginger ale with a long lemon peel.

name: Jack Rose
steps: Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
menuDescription: Apple brandy sour with grenadine.

name: Brandy Crusta
steps: Sugar-rim a chilled glass and line it with a lemon spiral.
menuDescription: Cognac sour in a sugar-rimmed glass.

name: Harvard
menuDescription: Cognac Manhattan-style.

name: Negroni Sbagliato
steps: Add the aperitif and vermouth to a glass over ice.
Stir once and add an orange slice.
menuDescription: Negroni with prosecco instead of gin.

name: Hugo Spritz
steps: Add mint and elderflower liqueur to a wine glass with ice.
menuDescription: Light elderflower and mint spritz.

name: Grasshopper
steps: Shake all ingredients hard with ice.
Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
menuDescription: Creamy mint and chocolate dessert drink.

name: Garibaldi
steps: Top with fluffy orange juice, shaken or blended with few ice.
notes: Aerating the juice gives a frothy top.
menuDescription: Bitter red aperitif with fluffy orange juice.

name: Midori Sour
steps: Shake liqueur, lemon and syrup with ice.
menuDescription: Sweet-tart melon liqueur sour.

name: Pimm's Cup
steps: Fill a tall glass with ice and fruit.
menuDescription: English summer fruit cup with lemonade.

name: White Negroni
menuDescription: Pale, floral take on the Negroni.

name: Mudslide
menuDescription: Creamy coffee and cream liqueur dessert drink.

name: Campari Soda
menuDescription: Bitter red aperitif lengthened with soda.

name: Golden Cadillac
steps: Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
menuDescription: Sweet, creamy vanilla and cacao dessert drink.

name: Limoncello Spritz
steps: Fill a wine glass with ice.
Top with soda and stir lightly.
menuDescription: Lemon liqueur spritz with prosecco.

name: Rossini
steps: Pour the puree into a chilled flute.
menuDescription: Strawberry puree and prosecco.

name: Sgroppino
steps: Whisk the sorbet and vodka until creamy.
menuDescription: Lemon sorbet, vodka and prosecco as a frothy dessert drink.

name: Black Velvet
steps: Fill a flute halfway with stout.
Pour the sparkling wine slowly over a spoon.
notes: Pouring slowly keeps the layers.
menuDescription: Layered stout and sparkling wine.

name: Wine Spritzer
steps: Fill a wine glass with ice.
menuDescription: White wine lightened with soda.

name: Death in the Afternoon
steps: Pour absinthe into a chilled flute.
menuDescription: Absinthe topped with sparkling wine.

name: Kalimotxo
steps: Fill a tall glass with ice.
menuDescription: Red wine and cola over ice.

name: Tinto de Verano
steps: Fill a tall glass with ice.
menuDescription: Spanish red wine and lemon soda cooler.

name: Poinsettia
steps: Add liqueur and cranberry juice to a flute.
menuDescription: Cranberry and orange liqueur with sparkling wine.

name: Champagne Cocktail
steps: Soak a sugar cube with the bitters in a flute.
menuDescription: Sugar and bitters sparkling wine classic.

name: Virgin Mojito
steps: Press lime, mint and syrup gently in the glass.
menuDescription: Alcohol-free mint and lime refresher.

name: Shirley Temple
steps: Top with ginger ale and garnish with cherry.
menuDescription: Alcohol-free ginger ale with grenadine.

name: Virgin Pina Colada
menuDescription: Creamy alcohol-free coconut and pineapple drink.

name: Cinderella
steps: Shake juices and grenadine with ice.
menuDescription: Alcohol-free fruit juice mix with a ginger ale top.

name: Arnold Palmer
steps: Fill a tall glass with ice.
menuDescription: Half iced tea and half lemonade.

name: Virgin Mary
steps: Add all to a glass with ice.
Garnish with celery and a lemon wedge.
menuDescription: Spiced tomato juice without alcohol.

name: Roy Rogers
steps: Add grenadine on top and stir.
menuDescription: Cola and grenadine soft drink.

name: Ginger Lemonade
steps: Add lemon juice and ginger syrup.
menuDescription: Zesty alcohol-free ginger and lemon cooler.

name: Long Beach Iced Tea
steps: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Add the four spirits, triple sec and lemon juice.
Top with cranberry juice and stir gently.
notes: Cranberry replaces the cola and gives a pink color.
menuDescription: Five-spirit iced tea with cranberry and lemon.

name: Tokyo Tea
steps: Shake the spirits, melon liqueur, lemon juice and syrup with ice.
Strain into an ice-filled highball glass.
menuDescription: Green melon twist on the iced tea family.

name: Texas Tea
steps: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Add the five spirits, triple sec and lemon juice.
Top with cola and stir gently.
menuDescription: Long Island Iced Tea with a shot of bourbon.

name: Electric Iced Tea
steps: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Add the four spirits, blue curacao and lemon juice.
Top with lemon-lime soda and stir gently.
menuDescription: Bright blue iced tea with citrus and soda.

name: Adios
steps: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Add spirits, blue curacao, lemon juice and syrup.
Top with soda and stir gently.
notes: Also called AMF.
menuDescription: Blue four-spirit highball with lemon and soda.

name: Scorpion
steps: Blend all ingredients with a scoop of crushed ice.
notes: Can be shaken and served over ice instead.
menuDescription: Rum and brandy tiki classic with orange and almond.

name: Fish House Punch
steps: Grate a little nutmeg on top.
notes: Traditionally batched in a punch bowl.
menuDescription: Old Philadelphia punch of rum, cognac and peach.

name: Saratoga
steps: Stir all ingredients with ice until cold.
menuDescription: Rye and cognac stirred with sweet vermouth.

name: Suffering Bastard
steps: Add spirits, lime juice, syrup and bitters to a glass with ice.
menuDescription: Gin and brandy lengthened with lime and ginger beer.

name: Corpse Reviver No. 1
steps: Stir all ingredients with ice until cold.
menuDescription: Cognac and apple brandy stirred with vermouth.

name: Fog Cutter
steps: Shake all ingredients except the sherry with ice.
Strain into a tiki glass over crushed ice.
Float the sherry on top and add mint.
menuDescription: Tiki long drink of rum, cognac and gin with citrus.

name: Tom and Jerry
steps: Warm a mug with hot water and empty it.
Add the egg batter, rum and cognac.
Top with hot milk, stir and grate nutmeg on top.
notes: Batter is egg, sugar and spices whipped together.
menuDescription: Warm holiday drink of rum, cognac, egg and milk.

name: Eggnog
notes: Use very fresh eggs.
menuDescription: Creamy festive drink of cognac and rum with egg and spice.

name: Prince of Wales
steps: Stir the first four ingredients with ice.
menuDescription: Rye and cognac topped with champagne.
